personal.name: A Masrur Ahmed
personal.title: PhD
personal.bio: A dedicated data scientist with experience in applied AI (deep and machine learning) techniques for air quality, bias correction, hydrology, water resources, and climate extremes. My professional experience in building robust Machine Learning solutions for business and my PhD research experience has helped me to gain in-depth knowledge of hydrology and water resources. I have an ever-evolving research profile with ten years of experience. I am keen to build a career in applied data science and artificial intelligence to understand data and make impactful data-driven decisions.

experience.title: Research Scholar
experience.description: Developed cutting edge hybrid deep learning algorithms for early warning forecasting hydrological scenarios for the Australian Murray Darling Basin.
highlights: Predicting hydrological variables (water level, rainfall, and soil moisture)
Developed hybrid deep learning models (i.e., LSTM, GRU, CNN-LSTM)
Worked with multiple ML methods (i.e., MLA, MARS, SVR and RF)
Applied multiple feature selection approaches (i.e., PSO, GA and GWO)
Used different feature decomposition methods (EEMD and CEEMDAN)
Used different datasets from ECMWF, GCM, AWRA, SILO and BOM
